name: Tsuma Youji 2 ~Boku wa Hitozuma Tenjouin~
original_name: 妻ようじ2～ボクは人妻添乗員～
source:
The main character is a tour conductor. One day, a group of married women boards his tour bus. But they never listen to him, touring around as they like. What should he do? Will the tour end safe and sound...?

[From ErogeShop]
